title.en: Name a conversation when you create it
title.zh: 新建会话时可直接填写标题

description.en: The New conversation dialog has an optional title field. Left blank, the conversation is still named after its first message.
description.zh: 「新建会话」中新增选填的标题项；留空时仍按第一条消息自动命名。

title.en: A tidier member list in the sidebar
title.zh: 侧边栏成员列表更清晰

description.en: It shows up to five people with whoever is online first, and no longer greys out teammates you haven't messaged. The + button now invites new members.
description.zh: 最多显示五人，在线成员排在前面，未私信过的成员不再显示为灰色；「+」按钮改为邀请新成员。

title.en: Download a file the moment an agent makes it
title.zh: 智能体刚生成的文件可立即下载

description.en: In the panel beside a conversation, download and copy link are available as soon as a new file opens.
description.zh: 在会话旁的面板中打开新文件后，即可下载和复制链接，无需等待。

title.en: The workspace keeps its layout in a narrow window
title.zh: 窗口较窄时工作区布局保持完整

description.en: Shrinking the window no longer switches to a phone-style layout; the sidebar, list and conversation stay side by side.
description.zh: 缩小窗口后不再切换为手机样式，侧边栏、列表和会话仍并排显示。

title.en: Intro slides no longer cover the page dots
title.zh: 介绍页不再遮挡底部的页码圆点

description.en: At any window size the slides fill the window cleanly, with the dots and buttons below them always in view.
description.zh: 任意窗口尺寸下，介绍页都完整铺满窗口，底部的圆点和按钮始终可见。
